translations.web: He said to them, “When you pray, say, ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.
translations.bsb: So Jesus told them, “When you pray, say: ‘Father, hallowed be Your name. Your kingdom come.
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.
translations.asv: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Father, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come.
